top_strength: Chauntelle expertly gathered detailed logistics information—large items, special handling needs (TV dismount, bed disassembly), plant count, wardrobe box requirements—and used that specificity to personalize the time estimate with transparent reasoning (bunk bed uncertainty = 1.5 additional hours for safety).
coaching_note: The call skipped the foundational Section 1 quid pro quo (no time-box, no promise of dependable quote, no wait for yes), never asked about the customer's concerns or agenda, never asked "Does that feel fair?" after pricing, and made no explicit ask for the business—you booked a reservation but didn't close the sale; go back to the script and front-load the open with the full framing, ask their agenda before probing, and ask plainly for the job.
